reader.requirement: At --std 85 a Report Section entry may omit data-name-1, but a report group named by GENERATE or USE BEFORE REPORTING, a sum counter referenced in the Procedure or Report Section, a detail named in a SUM UPON phrase and an entry used as a sum-counter qualifier must carry a data-name that the compiler resolves; a reference that names no such entry, an ambiguous unqualified sum counter, or a reference to a non-sum entry must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel >= 2002 returns null; at 85 a sum counter named by a clause of another data-division section resolves as a data-name (no 2002 section rule)
DialectLevel < 2002 words the refusal of a non-sum entry by §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR10d instead of the 2023 section rule; the refusal itself is the same
DialectLevel < 2002 refuses an UPON detail of another report (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2); resolution of the name itself is shared
takes the EditionContext only to report diagnostics; the name lookup is the same at every edition

reader.edition-search: Grep of ReportSectionBinder.cs for DialectLevel/Edition (sites 4178, 4211, 4249, 4359, 4634, 4699 read); ReportWriterBinder BindGenerate and ReportGroupResolution.Resolve read.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a sum counter is a data-name usable by clauses of other data-division sections and a non-sum entry reference is refused under SR10d; at 2002+ the section rule refuses such clause references and an UPON detail may belong to another report. GENERATE/USE resolution and ambiguity refusal are the same.

reader.notes: All four cases of GR1 resolve through named entries, and each refusal half is diagnosed at --std 85. Witness g85_bf09_06 matches its golden. The 85-specific arms (sum counter as a data-name, SR10d refusal, same-report UPON) were probed or read and follow the 1985 text.
